title: Fall Creek and the renewal of blueberry varieties
summary: Spanish-language trade coverage describing 'FC11-164' as mid-season with exceptional firmness and storage durability, and noting that matching the productivity of other new varieties is its principal remaining challenge.
why_it_matters: One of the few pieces of trade commentary that records a limitation rather than only repeating a company strength claim. The productivity caveat is a useful counterweight to the owner's framing.

reading.rationale: Records a limitation that is absent from owner materials.

testing.rationale: Yield is directly measurable and is the stated open question.

commercial_position.rationale: Only matters commercially if the variety reaches scale.

monitoring.rationale: Follow up when yield data is published.
